PLAN "2-Week Hotel Room Maintenance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain muscle and strength while traveling"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Body Pull and Push":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
          arm_circles 1 minute
          cat_cow 1 minute
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          prone_Y 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 minute
          lat_stretch 1 minute
          child_pose 1 minute
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          marching 2 minutes
          leg_swings 1 minute
          hip_circles 1 minute
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1 minute
          quad_stretch 1 minute
          pigeon_pose 1 minute
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Pull Emphasis and Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
          arm_circles 1 minute
          scapular_retraction 1 minute
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 seconds rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1 minute
          shoulder_stretch 1 minute
          spinal_twist 1 minute
      DAY Friday training 40m "Lower Body and Glutes":
        warmup:
          high_knees 1 minute
          leg_swings 1 minute
          hip_circles 1 minute
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_placeholder 0x0 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 1 minute
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 minute
          child_pose 1 minute
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Body Pull and Push":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
          arm_circles 1 minute
          cat_cow 1 minute
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          prone_Y 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 minute
          lat_stretch 1 minute
          child_pose 1 minute

goals.name: Maintain muscle and strength while traveling
